name: Button Mushroom

high.description: Standard serving is high in mannitol

siboNotes: Button mushrooms, cremini, and portobello (all the same species at different stages) are high in polyols and should be avoided during SIBO treatment. Use oyster mushrooms or canned mushrooms as alternatives.
preparationTips: Canned mushrooms are lower in FODMAPs due to processing
nutritionalHighlights: Provides vitamin D (if exposed to UV)
